title: Conditional κ = 7.22869827347495e-4: a new paired-cube bit word (arc-aware local circuit, centre-sharing pair module) in the five-stage completed banks
body:
**κ = 144573965469499/(2·10¹⁷) = 7.22869827347495e-4**, conditional, with the bit supplier binding.

| compared with | κ | gain |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| highest open claim when I wrote this (#275, 04:17 UTC Oct 10) | 7.13690108083058e-4 | **+1.29%** |
| the source527 package (#210 head), whose machinery this reuses | 7.10069340338651e-4 | +1.80% |

The gain does not come from frame or entrance tuning. It comes from a **new paired-cube bit word (gen4)** whose virtual circuit needs 1,004 fewer
auxiliary roles than PR200's. Here that word is carried through the complete five-stage completed-bank
package.

```sh
cd research/five-stage-gen4-banks
python3 -m pip install -r requirements.txt     # sympy==1.14.0
python3 -B verify.py --output /tmp/gen4-five-stage-verification     # about 5 minutes, no network
```

## What changed

There is one new self-contained package, `research/five-stage-gen4-banks/`, plus its own path-filtered
workflow `.github/workflows/five-stage-gen4-banks.yml`, which runs `verify.py` and the regeneration on
Python 3.11 and 3.13. No existing file changes.
It is eumemic's source527 five-stage package (PR234 layout, stage-private width-120 completed banks,
parity fusion, exact geometry, primes, finite bill and outer assembly) with the bit helper replaced.

| one invocation, m = 120 | source527 (#210 head) | **gen4 (this PR)** |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| virtual auxiliary roles | 18,908 (PR200 word) | **17,904** |
| compensated reuse pairs | 1,760 | 1,494 |
| source loans / terminal sinks | 527 / 34 | 0 / 0 |
| independent dirty registers R | 16,587 | **16,410** |
| independent entrances | 2,279 | 2,466 (2,200 rank 20, 266 rank 21) |
| literal stock (60 replicas) | 1,304,935 | 1,283,035 |
| normalized stock / deficit | 260,987 / 52,800 | 256,607 / 52,800 |
| bit coarse saving | 7.10573897320284e-4 | **7.23392746398452e-4** |
| κ | 7.10069340338651e-4 | **7.22869827347495e-4** |

The complex supplier is unchanged: PR234/PR193, coarse 7.47454944651775e-4. The bit side still binds, so
the remaining headroom on this layout is about 3.3%.

## The gen4 bit word

PR168's p = 12 word is kept: the same roots, decoder and partner-pair mixing. Three parts of the circuit
change, and R = c + q − |M| falls from 19,788 (main) or 18,908 (PR200) to 17,904.

| region (additions − carrier arcs) | PR168 L1 | gen4 |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| per-cube local channels (220 cubes) | 22 each | **16 each** |
| pair module + copied centre (24) | 191 each | **184 each** |
| all-but-one module (132) | 15 each | **12 each** |

1. **Arc-aware local design.** Every plane channel is any recipe tree of support-disjoint additions, not
   only PR144/189/200's edge, face-diagonal and fixed-coordinate options. Each cube uses 29 additions,
   but they create 13 in-place carrier arcs instead of 4: five partner-root arcs from the flip01
   face-diagonal pairs, and eight chain arcs. A CP-SAT model over all 15 recipe trees per plane proves
   that debt 16 per cube is optimal.
2. **Centre-sharing pair module.** The pair module's 56th root is star(2i+bit), the sum of all 55 inputs.
   It costs 10 extra additions on module nodes, replacing a separate 34-addition centre tree.
3. **Re-annealed all-but-one module.** It has 34 additions and 22 arcs.

Its physical layer applies PR200's rules with new producers:

- 1,494 compensated late-read reuse pairs, from a maximum Hopcroft–Karp matching;
- 1,802 descended operation frames: equal-frame groups moved to the join of their inputs or the meet of
  their outputs, accepted only when the five-stage cost falls.

## What `verify.py` checks (9 mandatory stages)

- **virtual:** eumemic's PR168-v4 package checker on the virtual word, unmodified. It covers exact
  frames, the mod-2 decoder, geometry, chains, G-nondegeneracy, the F₂ replay and the ledger recount,
  with all five of its mutation controls rejected. The stage then runs PR200's physical-word proof,
  unmodified and exactly as PR200's `prove.py` runs it:
  - all 1,802 changed frames and 1,494 handoffs;
  - the physical row: phase one, actual operands, nested chains, deficit;
  - the physical word on all 19,930 columns over F₂ and the integer decoder;
  - four adverse controls rejected.
- **raw:** a fresh census of every physical source, internal and target path, with both reflected
  ledgers.
- **bit:** the source527 event emitter and parity fusion (1,510,656 even payload ADDs elided, no MOVE
  merged), then PR234's five-stage global lowering (487,546 paid calls, deficit 4,400). Exact rational
  h=24/m=120 geometry covers two actual ports, two rank-20 entrances and, newly, one rank-21 entrance.
- **scalar:** the source527 scalar program, byte-identical with all its selections empty. It runs on all
  19,930 formal F₂ columns and on the signed integer decoder in both directions. The emitted
  parity-filtered word and its literal inverse are checked independently on every column. Eleven
  actual-context corruptions are rejected; they replace the 25 source527 mutations, whose features gen4
  does not have.
- **primes:** cleared-Gram determinants of all 26,249 consumed bases, at most 118 bits; every residual is
  below 2⁸⁰.
- **banks:** 370 exact charts, with patterns (3⁴⁰) × 399, (4³⁰) × 4,400 and (24⁵) × 167,328. All
  4,923,000 role/replica/stage assignments are enumerated, and exactly the 2,466 rank-5a completions are
  removed.
- **complex, math, finite:** the retained complex supplier, two exact moment engines with the complete
  10⁻¹⁶ fallback (the adjacent bit grid point is rejected), all 47 strict outer inequalities and seven
  margins (the adjacent κ grid point is rejected), and the literal 60-replica finite bill with
  502,915,820,400 bank selector calls.

`gen4bit/producer/regenerate.py` rebuilds the five pinned bit-word files from the generator, the four
p = 12 data files and both producers, byte for byte, in about 2 minutes. This is provenance only:
`verify.py` never runs a producer.

I also replayed the package independently: a fresh copy, run from another directory under a clean
Python 3.12 + sympy 1.14.0 venv, gives the identical certificate.

Outside the package, two read-only audits imported no package code and used their own exact arithmetic
(FLINT and Bareiss). They reproduced:

- all 26,058 frames and the frame legality of every operation, including that labels equal actual values;
- all 1,494 aliases and every target chronology;
- an independent F₂ replay on all 19,930 columns;
- the helper ledger;
- the coarse saving and κ.

## Status

This is a conditional finite construction with the same retained interfaces as #210 and #234:

- the all-size weighted compiler and common ancestor charts;
- restored rows and completed ordinary leaves;
- selectors, exact-tape routing and prime supply;
- precision/recovery and retained complex symbolic correctness;
- analytic transfer.

There is no new Lean and no multiplier benchmark.

## Composes with

None of these is included, and each would re-pin the package's constants:

- the five-stage entrance and retiming work (#249–#270);
- PR210-style source loans;
- terminal sinks;
- more reuse pairs.

The bit word and these mechanisms act on different parts of the ledger.
